scope: WooCommerce performance PRs created in the last 36 hours, plus external gateway/plugin PRs and older June 26 PRs for project context.

last_36_hours.window_note: As of 2026-07-02T13:34:30Z, WooCommerce core PRs #16-#33, WooPayments PR #11914, and PayPal Payments PR #4494 were created within the previous 36 hours. Action Scheduler PR #1340 was also created in this window as the upstream fix candidate for the scheduler claim-index lane.

problems.profiling_link: Gateway-active PayPal settings and heavy HPOS order edit profiles showed repeated WooPayments WPCOM/Jetpack authorization work; PR #31 reduces Jetpack registration attempts from 3 to 1 in adjacent cold XHProf samples.

problems.problem: Jetpack/WPCOM registration retry after recent failure
problems.profiling_link: Gateway-active heavy HPOS order edit benchmark with a primed recent Jetpack registration failure: baseline made 6 jetpack.wordpress.com/jetpack.register/1/ calls across 3 requests, totalling 1874.587ms HTTP time; PR #33 made 0 calls, reduced median server time from 3423.44ms to 2672.36ms, and reduced median query count from 3242 to 3196.

Gateway-stack variable-product page with 800 variations showed WooPayments multicurrency selected-currency resolution in the hot path about 40k times. PR #11914 reduced median total time from 1361.273ms to 1239.675ms and dropped get_selected_currency inclusive XHProf time from 616.212ms to 6.643ms.

In a primed-failure XHProf/HTTP trace, PR #4494 reduced PayPal merchant-integration HTTP calls from 3/3 requests to 0/3 while leaving the separate Jetpack/WooPayments calls for core PR #31.

problems.problem: Shipping postcode-zone location reloads across split-package lookups

Default one-package cart still needs the separate normalized-index direction.
